subcategory_text: Policies, processes, and procedures are established and in place to receive, analyze, and respond to problematic data actions disclosed to the organization from internal and external sources (e.g., internal discovery, privacy researchers, professional events).
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SI-5 (Information System Alerts and Advisories), PM-15
implementation_examples: Establish intake channels (privacy mailbox, researcher disclosure programme, bug bounty for privacy researchers) for internal and external sources to disclose problematic data actions
Triage, investigate, and respond to disclosures within documented timeframes
Maintain records of disclosures and handling decisions for accountability
assessment_objectives: Determine whether intake channels exist and are published
Determine whether disclosures are triaged within documented timeframes
Determine whether responses include corrective actions and lessons learned
Determine whether disclosure records are preserved
